checks.http: PASS live HTTPS share image, notices, robots, sitemap and 404
checks.live: PASS live HTTPS gallery, both locales, independent WebGPU output, non-evolving original-CSS A/A/B/A controls, native frozen pause, source SHA, same-origin network and backlinks. Evolving form differences are diagnostics; semantic acceptance belongs to the fixed-candidate independent desktop/mobile three-form review. Canvas-hide checks are separate diagnostics.
